title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. Two blinded evidence batches now cover the major planets and nine high-information satellite/boundary cases, with 82/300 evidence-state cells coded from NASA/JPL sources while all cases remain unexposed to QCA results.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 froze the case frame, raw-variable architecture, model ladder and evidence protocol before analysis. Pilot-1 built and source-hardened the data spine. Evidence batches 01 and 02 now code 19 bodies, including planet-like large moons and ocean-world counterexamples. Protocol v0.2 explicitly separates present/persistent oceans from paleo-ocean evidence. No QCA calibration or solution inspection has occurred.

tables.status: case frame + physical + orbit + derived + evidence v0.3
